operators.name: sum_dim1_forward
semantics: Computes torch.sum(x, dim=1), reducing the channel dimension (C) completely.
Input shape [N, C, H, W] -> output shape [N, H, W].
Output elements are sums over all C values at corresponding spatial positions.
For each n, h, w: out[n,h,w] = sum_{c=0}^{C-1} x[n,c,h,w].
Preserves float32 dtype and CUDA device, output is contiguous.

operators.name: relu_forward
semantics: Computes element-wise ReLU activation: out[i] = max(0, x[i]).
Input and output shapes are identical.
Preserves float32 dtype and CUDA device, output is contiguous.
Reduce tensor x along dimension 1 by summation.
Result is float32 tensor on CUDA.
Apply element-wise ReLU (max(0, value)) to x.
Result is float32 tensor on CUDA.
Return the ReLU-activated tensor as final model output.
